summary: Feed s071_single to IDS is degraded: 100% of packets are untagged and required VLANs 10, 20 are completely missing. All other checks (duplicates, one-way, packet drops, tool overload, encrypted share) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN/TAP is systematically stripping 802.1Q tags or forwarding from an access port / pruned trunk. 100% untagged across all sampled frames indicates a broker policy to strip VLAN headers or a SPAN configured without 802.1Q trunk encapsulation, not random loss.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires VLANs 10 and 20 for segmentation and detection coverage. Without tags it cannot attribute traffic to correct VLAN/tenant, misses VLAN-hopping, lateral movement and per-VLAN policy violations, leaving those segments effectively blind.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve and forward 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 through the packet broker to the IDS so VLAN-aware signatures and segmentation policies can be applied.
